question: Who stands liberated as a mere machine, and which sinners?
premises: liberated just then, stands a mere machine in time
liquor-drinker, theft-taker, brahmin-killer, teacher-bed-goer are named
inference: Even the great sinners stand as liberated machines when the time holds.
uncertainties: mahapataka list kept per gloss; machine-metaphor scope open
plain_english: Liberated just then, stands a mere machine in time — liquor-drinker, theft-taker, brahmin-killer, teacher-bed-goer.
